page.overview:
What is Adventure Nightmare Foxy?

is an unlockable character in FNaF World.

Nightmare Foxy's appearance is almost identical to his core series counterpart, but he is smaller, glossier, and has a shorter snout, which still appears cut almost halfway from the fur. He appears less torn up than usual. The right ear is ripped from his costume and the left ear has a huge rip. There are two huge cracks underneath his ears, along with a huge hole on both sides of his head. Like Adventure Foxy, he lacks animatronic fur from the knee down, revealing three-toed endoskeleton feet.

Nightmare Foxy can be treated like Adventure Withered Bonnie. Like Adventure Withered Bonnie, he has Unscrew 2 which has a 50% chance to destroy a single target. Bite 2 is good to quickly deal damage to most enemies as well as using Hot Cheese 2 that can do huge damage over time.
